incidents.what_happened: A boat carrying pilgrims from Odisha capsized after colliding with another boat near Man Mandir Ghat, and all on board were rescued.
incidents.quote: Around 60 devotees from Odisha were rescued safely after a boat carrying them collided with another boat

incidents.what_happened: Two young men celebrating with friends at Hanuman Ghat went into deep water in the Ganga and drowned.
incidents.cause: went into deep water while bathing
incidents.quote: They were celebrating with friends when they ventured too far and drowned.

incidents.what_happened: A group of Japanese tourists wearing swimwear was confronted by locals at Dashashwamedh Ghat and one of them was made to apologise.
incidents.cause: dispute over clothing at the ghat
incidents.quote: One of the tourists is seen apologising on the steps of the ghat, amid rising tensions.

incidents.what_happened: Police arrested five people for misbehaving with pilgrims and tourists and extorting money from them with promises of easy darshan at the Kashi Vishwanath Temple.
incidents.quote: The arrests were made near Gate No. 4 of the Shri Kashi Vishwanath Temple in the Chowk area on August 19.

incidents.what_happened: A 63-year-old pilgrim from Tamil Nadu slipped into deep water while bathing at Dandi Ghat and was rescued by the NDRF.
incidents.cause: slipped into deep water while bathing
incidents.quote: The man suddenly slipped into deep water while bathing in the Ganga and started drowning.
